shortcut_name: decimal digit uniqueness reduces the task to exact cover
evidence: gpt-oss-120b uses "column ids: 0..k-1 -> X_1..X_k", "k..2k-1 -> Y_1..Y_k", "2k..3k-1 -> Z_1..Z_k", and "DLX structures".
affordance_in_statement: The signature is calculated using powers of 10 ... The ideal harmonic ... is defined as H_k = sum_{j=1}^k 10^j. A valid deployment ... must satisfy ... [each signature] exactly equals H_k.
removal_suggestion: Keep the same three signature equalities and the same examples, but use powers of 2 instead of powers of 10 for both the signatures and H_k. With a fixed selection size, binary carries allow repeated coordinate values to satisfy the equality, so it is no longer equivalent to covering every X, Y, and Z value exactly once.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Recognizes that each power-of-10 equality forces every coordinate value to occur exactly once, then solves the resulting 3-dimensional exact-cover instance with DLX.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: The three sums of powers of 10 must each equal H_k = sum_{j=1}^k 10^j.

common_affordance: The powers-of-10 representation makes each signature equality equivalent to requiring every coordinate value 1 through k exactly once.

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: Its mask DP implementation did not correctly maintain or reconstruct the required three-way exact-cover state; the submitted DP therefore produced a wrong answer.
It enumerates every k-subset using itertools.combinations, which is exponential in t and times out on the allowed bounds.
The submitted exact-cover/perfect-matching implementation terminated with a runtime error before producing a valid result.

recommended_edit: Replace every occurrence of 10^x, 10^y, 10^z, and H_k = sum 10^j with 2^x, 2^y, 2^z, and H_k = sum 2^j respectively, leaving the input/output format, bounds, and example values unchanged.
regression_risk: This could restore the defeated DP or matching approaches if they solve the resulting binary-weighted subset problem correctly, although it directly invalidates the surviving DLX exact-cover reduction.
